items.title: Sister Bernice Phillips Interview, 1960-09-03
items.q: Jerry. Jerry. When we made them records, did they have a banjo player here?

ctx.x: I don't think we used my husband on him.
Just George and Baby Dodge. Jerry. Jerry. When we made them records, did they have a banjo player here? Yes. Who? What? It was Lawrence, I believe. It was Lawrence. Yes, Lawrence.
